title: Sound and Music
summary: Playing sound effects and streaming music with raylib's audio module - the audio device, Sound versus Music, volume and pitch, playing the same sound many times at once, a little random variation, and volume settings in decibels and percentages.

cards.q: When do you use Sound and when Music?
cards.a: Sound for short effects loaded fully into memory; Music for long tracks streamed from the file.

cards.q: What happens if you forget UpdateMusicStream?
cards.a: The stream's buffer is not refilled, so the music stops almost straight away.
Playing a Sound that is already playing restarts it; aliases let several copies play at the same time.
